title: Item
description: The unit of dispatch: an item of kind work or external (design part 3.2). An external item is work someone the system cannot dispatch completes: the owner by hand, a contributor, an upstream project or a vendor; waiting_on names who. Decisions have their own schema. In the files backend the body holds the sections Why, Done when, Plan and Notes; this schema covers the front matter. Derived fields (claimed, ready, blocked, stage, critical_path, lead_time) are never stored.

owner.description: Who is accountable for this record. Defaults to the owner: the person who holds the project's decision rights.

opened_from.description: Signal, project or decision IDs this was opened from.

needs.description: IDs that must be done before this is ready.

touches.description: Path globs the item is expected to change.

resources.description: What this machine must have for the item to run here, such as gpu or browser (design part 13.4). An item that needs a resource the machine lacks is not dispatched here, and the orchestrator says why.

serial.description: Serial resources the item needs, such as gpu.

tier_override.description: The tier the owner or the shaper set, over the one sizing derives.

release_note.description: One line for the release notes, if the item changes public surface.

release.description: On a release item: the version it makes, such as 0.1.0-rc.1 (design part 3.2, Release). One release item per package and version. Milestones are never named by version.

package.description: On a release item: the release package it releases, one declared in policy.json release.packages. Required when more than one package is declared; with one, it is that one. Other items belong to packages by the files they touch, never by this key.

source_issue.description: The number of the forge issue the item comes from, when triage filed it from one. The release that first ships the item lists the issue, so the ship step closes it with a comment naming the release; a pull request for the item refers to it and never closes it.

claim.description: Set by the claim commit on the executor's branch.
